title: Average randomized clause value
statement: Let $b\in\{\pm1\}$ and let $\mu_0,\mu_1,\mu_2\in[-1,1]$. Average over the four triples of signs whose product is $1$ the randomized acceptance value of the clause that accepts unless its three inputs equal the corresponding falsifying signs (with the first falsifying sign adjusted by $b$). This average equals $3/4$ plus one quarter of the randomized acceptance value of the predicate that accepts when the product of three independently randomized signs equals $b$, where the signs have respective means $\mu_0,\mu_1,\mu_2$.
hypotheses_covered: Each of the three means belongs to $[-1,1]$
